title: Biclosed matrix convolution structure
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let $\mathbf V=\operatorname{Ch}(R)$ carry the projective closed monoidal structure of [lem-coef-projective-chains-monoidal-model]. For a small set $S$, let $\mathbf G_S$ be the graph category with coordinatewise model structure of [lem-coef-graph-product-model]. Define $(P\star Q)(s,t)=\bigoplus_{u\in S}P(u,t)\otimes Q(s,u)$ and $E(s,t)=R[0]$ for $s=t$ and $0$ otherwise. Then $\star$ is an associative unital biclosed monoidal product (not assumed symmetric). The functor $P\star-$ is left adjoint to $R_P$, and $-\star Q$ is left adjoint to $L_Q$, with products of internal Hom complexes given by $R_P(H)(s,u)=\prod_t\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}(P(u,t),H(s,t))$ and $L_Q(H)(u,t)=\prod_s\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}(Q(s,u),H(s,t))$.

source.place: Muro Definition 10.1, pp. 1595-1596 (PDF pages 55-56): matrix tensor, diagonal unit, and the two internal-Hom adjoints, specialized to the closed symmetric monoidal category of complexes.
